messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand and improve the existing Portuguese village-building game in `index.html`, adding faster time controls, a larger map, improved visuals, evolving defenses, periodic enemies, and toolmaking gameplay.

## Requirements
- User requested time controls up to 60×, larger maps, better-looking buildings and overall graphics, village-evolving walls, periodic barbarian hordes and attacking animals, and blacksmiths/artisans to improve tools through gameplay.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; build the playable game and briefly note assumptions when finishing.

## Decisions
- Expanded the map from 15×9 to 22×14 tiles.
- Changed save key to `terra-reino-save-v2` to accommodate the updated map/state.
- Added a four-button speed selector for 1×, 8×, 45×, and 60×.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing single-file game implementation.
- Updated map dimensions, canvas dimensions, and canvas aspect ratio.
- Replaced the cycling speed button with explicit speed buttons including 60×.
- Added a Ferramentas resource and initial building definitions for blacksmith, artisan, and militia post.
- Adjusted the initial camp position and added initial raid/beast scheduling fields to fresh state.

### Active
- Integrate the new buildings/resource into production, rendering, UI, and combat/gameplay.
- Implement village-evolving perimeter walls, barbarian raids, and animal attacks.
- Improve visual design and verify the game in-browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue updating `index.html` so the new tools resource works across all resource calculations and display paths.
2. Implement defensive wall progression and periodic raids/animal attacks with readable event feedback and survivable gameplay.
3. Improve map/building graphics, then run the game and check a screenshot and basic gameplay interactions.
4. Briefly summarize assumptions and completed changes to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game UI, simulation, map rendering, buildings, and controls; all current edits are here.

## Important Context
- Current edits are partial and unverified; additional changes are required before the game is playable with the requested systems.
- Changed constants: `W=22`, `H=14`, `TILE=64`, `SAVE_KEY='terra-reino-save-v2'`; canvas is `1408×896`.
- New building IDs: `smith`, `artisan`, and `guard`; new resource ID: `tools`.
- Fresh state includes `toolLevel:0`, `nextRaid:-9940`, `nextBeast:-9970`, and `enemies:[]`.
- Existing simulation/rendering assumes five resources in several places; adding `tools` requires checking those assumptions.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the Portuguese village-building game in `index.html`, including faster time controls, a larger map, improved visuals, evolving walls, periodic attacks, and toolmaking.

## Requirements
- Deliver a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; briefly state assumptions when finishing.
- Support speeds up to 60×, a larger map, periodic barbarian and animal attacks, and gameplay-based tool upgrades.

## Decisions
- Expand the map to 22×14 tiles and use save key `terra-reino-save-v2`.
- Provide speed buttons at 1×, 8×, 45×, and 60×.
- Scale walls by building count and era; schedule attacks by in-game year.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the larger map, speed controls, Ferramentas resource, blacksmith/artisan/militia buildings, tool upgrades, walls, attack logic, and custom building/enemy visuals.
- Extracted the game script and ran `node --check` successfully before the latest small edit.
- Inspected simulation, saves, rendering, and game interactions in `index.html`.

### Active
- Validate save/load compatibility, attack scheduling, simulation, and rendering; fix any issues found.
- Run the game in a browser and verify core interactions, visuals, and save/load behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix potential save/load and simulation inconsistencies.
2. Run browser-based checks for gameplay, map rendering, speed controls, attacks, and save/load; capture and inspect a screenshot.
3. Summarize the delivered changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; all current changes are here.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` showed `M index.html`.
- Existing v1 saves are not migrated; `load()` only accepts the current save key and checks grid row count.
- `step()` advances periodic attacks with `while` loops, and `gameLoop()` currently uses a time-modulo condition for periodic UI rendering.
- The latest edit added `lastRender` to the state declarations, but it is not yet used.
